chapter.heading: A song for pilgrims going up to Jerusalem.
chapter.v:
Praise the
Lord, all you servants of the Lord who worship at night in the house of the Lord.

Lift up
your hands towards the holy place and praise the Lord.

May the
Lord bless you from Zion, he who made the heavens and the earth.
